% ---- Small helpers ------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\marker}{\tikz[baseline=-0.6ex]{\fill[gold] (0,0)--(1.3pt,1.3pt)--(2.6pt,0)--(1.3pt,-1.3pt)--cycle;}}
\newcommand{\eyebrow}[1]{{\caps\fontsize{6.4}{8}\selectfont\color{gfair}#1}}
\newcommand{\goldbrow}[1]{{\caps\fontsize{6.4}{8}\selectfont\color{gold}#1}}

% A double hairline: the frame device the whole site is built on.
\newcommand{\doublerule}{%
  \par\vspace{3pt}%
  {\color{gprim}\hrule height 0.4pt}%
  \vspace{1.6pt}%
  {\color{ivory}\hrule height 0.4pt}%
  \par\vspace{3pt}}
\newcommand{\hairrule}{\par\vspace{2pt}{\color{ivory}\hrule height 0.4pt}\par\vspace{2pt}}

% A centred ornament, as under the headings on the site.
\newcommand{\ornament}{%
  \par\vspace{2pt}
  \begin{center}
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \draw[gold,line width=0.3pt] (-1.5,0) -- (-0.22,0);
    \fill[gold] (0,0) circle (1.1pt);
    \draw[gold,line width=0.3pt] (0.22,0) -- (1.5,0);
  \end{tikzpicture}
  \end{center}
  \vspace{1pt}}

% ---- The crest ----------------------------------------------
% Redrawn from assets/img/crest.svg. SVG y grows downward, so
% every y here is (100 - y_svg).
\newcommand{\crest}[1]{%
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=#1mm,y=#1mm,line cap=round,line join=round]
  \draw[gprim,line width=1.4pt] (50,50) circle (47);
  \draw[gprim,line width=0.7pt] (50,50) circle (43);
  \draw[gprim,line width=1.4pt] (50,56) circle (11);
  \draw[gprim,line width=1.3pt] (14,38)--(28,52)--(38,43)--(50,57)--(62,43)--(72,52)--(86,38);
  \draw[gprim,line width=1.6pt,opacity=0.72] (14,29)--(26,40)--(36,33)--(50,45)--(64,33)--(74,40)--(86,29);
  \draw[gprim,line width=1.9pt,opacity=0.45] (14,21)--(30,30)--(44,23)--(56,29)--(70,22)--(86,21);
\end{tikzpicture}}

% ---- Scorecard columns --------------------------------------
% Fixed widths so the two nine-hole blocks line up exactly.
% tabcolsep is added on BOTH sides of EVERY column, and at its 6pt
% default that is two full inches of padding across twelve columns --
% which silently pushed OUT / IN / TOT clean off the page. Pin it low.
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{1pt}
\arrayrulecolor{ivory}
% 0.4pt is the LaTeX default and renders inconsistently on screen
% at typical zoom -- it looked like the rules were broken.
\setlength{\arrayrulewidth}{0.5pt}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{0.95}
\newcolumntype{L}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.50in}}
\newcolumntype{H}{>{\centering\arraybackslash}p{0.330in}}
\newcolumntype{T}{>{\centering\arraybackslash}p{0.40in}}

\newcommand{\logrow}{\rule[-3.5pt]{0pt}{11pt}}    % room for L / B / half

\newcolumntype{R}{>{\centering\arraybackslash}p{0.315in}}
